correctness.rationale: The exact four-population ODE reduction and Lyapunov identity give global positive coexistence attraction. The total-abundance linearization is Hurwitz while the two composition modes rotate at frequency sqrt(p*rho*n*h). Solving the quadratic center-manifold invariance equations yields an explicit slaving polynomial; averaged quartic energy drift is -kappa E^2 with strictly positive rational kappa, independently reproduced from squared total-abundance dissipation. An oscillation-removing energy correction proves tE -> 1/kappa; stable-fiber tracking extends this law to every positive nonbalanced trajectory. The complete standalone verification program passed exact symbolic reduction, invariance, coefficient-equivalence and benchmark assertions, plus two finite-time numerical diagnostics. The numerical checks alone prove no infinite limit.

value.rationale: The natural weighted type-frequency imbalance is an ecological invariant observable of transient phenotypic cycling. Exact positive coexistence attraction was known, but a long-lived undamped-looking trajectory relaxation exponent and exact amplitude were not quantified. This theorem distinguishes exponentially balanced dynamics from universal algebraically damped Red-Queen-like type cycling, gives the strictly positive sign and closed-form ecological parameter dependence for all admissible coefficients, and informs deterministic crossover time scales. The narrow quantitative invariant is motivated by the original paper's transient oscillatory mechanisms; no unproved implications about stochastic dynamics or general network systems are asserted.
